mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(e.event_id AS VARCHAR) AS event_id, e.event_type, e.decision_st, e.event_at, l.location_nm AS location_name, a.patient_nm AS patient_name, h.emp_nm AS staff_name, a.crt_dt AS action_at, a.action_content, w.ward_nm AS ward_name,
CASE WHEN m.media_st = 'READY' THEN '/api/admin/events/' || CAST(e.event_id AS VARCHAR) || '/media' ELSE COALESCE(e.event_detail ->> 'video_url', e.event_detail ->> 'videoUrl', '') END AS video_url,
(m.viewed_at IS NOT NULL) AS video_viewed,
COALESCE(a.patient_nm IN ('오경보', '확인') AND a.action_content IN ('오경보 확인', '낙상 의심 확인', '침대 이탈 확인'), FALSE) AS dismissed FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id LEFT JOIN tb_event_action a ON a.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN tb_emp h ON h.emp_id = a.handler_id LEFT JOIN tb_event_media m ON m.event_id = e.event_id WHERE w.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND e.event_type = 'FALL'
AND (e.decision_st = 'CONFIRMED' OR (e.decision_st = 'SUSPECTED' AND a.action_id IS NOT NULL))
AND e.decision_st = 'CONFIRMED'
AND (e.event_detail ->> 'duplicate_of') IS NULL
AND w.ward_id = #{wardId}
ORDER BY e.event_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(e.event_id AS VARCHAR) AS event_id, e.event_type, e.decision_st, e.event_at, l.location_nm AS location_name, l.location_type, (a.action_id IS NOT NULL) AS handled,
COALESCE(a.patient_nm IN ('오경보', '확인') AND a.action_content IN ('오경보 확인', '낙상 의심 확인', '침대 이탈 확인'), FALSE) AS dismissed FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id LEFT JOIN tb_event_action a ON a.event_id = e.event_id WHERE w.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND w.ward_id = #{wardId} AND ( e.event_at >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') OR (e.event_type = 'FALL' AND e.decision_st = 'CONFIRMED' AND e.event_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') ) AND (e.event_detail ->> 'duplicate_of') IS NULL ORDER BY e.event_at

SELECT w.hosp_div_id AS hospital_id, w.ward_id FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE e.event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_event_action ( event_id, handler_id, patient_nm, action_content ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID), #{handlerId}, #{patientName}, #{actionContent} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_detection_event SET decision_st = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID) AND event_type = 'FALL' AND decision_st = 'SUSPECTED'
